headline: Six Sectors Command the Latest Front Dispatch
war_summary: The latest ledger shifts the main watch toward six unsettled sectors, with Nevish Line now the busiest recorded front: 43 base events in 24 hours, 15 in the latest two-hour window, and a ledger of five Warden, two Colonial, and one neutral base. Linn Mercy follows with 24 events, including four recent, while its current count stands at eight Colonial and three neutral bases. Weathered Expanse remains highly fluid at 52 daily events and three in the latest watch, with three Warden, two Colonial, and four neutral holdings. Marban Hollow has edged up to 26 events, though only one falls in the latest two hours; its bases now divide four Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral. Mooring County records 11 daily events and one recent movement, despite retaining all twelve bases under Warden control. Stonecradle has five daily events and sharply rising casualty and enlistment rates, with seven Colonial and two Warden bases. Elsewhere, Kuura Strand’s seven daily events are older, and several fronts show fighting without fresh ownership changes.
